name: diff-receiver-sensitivity
description: Differential receiver input-referred threshold and output levels at ±200 mV, at the three common-mode points §4 names (0.8 / 1.65 / 2.5 V).
claim: spec/usb2-device-phy.md#4-receiver-set -- differential input sensitivity |(D+) − (D−)| > 200 mV over a common-mode input range of 0.8-2.5 V; and spec/usb2-device-phy.md#82-what-gets-measured-and-against-which-section row 'Receiver thresholds' (differential receiver half).
derive: meas dc rxd1_hi FIND v(rxd1) AT=0.2
meas dc rxd1_lo FIND v(rxd1) AT=-0.2
meas dc rxd2_hi FIND v(rxd2) AT=0.2
meas dc rxd2_lo FIND v(rxd2) AT=-0.2
meas dc rxd3_hi FIND v(rxd3) AT=0.2
meas dc rxd3_lo FIND v(rxd3) AT=-0.2

vth_cm080_mv.description: spec §4: a 200 mV differential input must be resolved at the 0.8 V low end of the common-mode range, i.e. the input-referred switching threshold must sit inside ±200 mV

vth_cm165_mv.description: spec §4: same, at the 1.65 V midpoint of the common-mode range

vth_cm250_mv.description: spec §4: same, at the 2.5 V high end of the common-mode range

hi_cm080.description: spec §4: at D+ − D− = +200 mV the receiver output must be a valid logic high (≥ 0.9 × VDD), not merely past its threshold

lo_cm080.description: spec §4: at D+ − D− = −200 mV the receiver output must be a valid logic low (≤ 0.1 × VDD)

hi_cm165.description: as hi_cm080, at the 1.65 V common-mode point

lo_cm165.description: as lo_cm080, at the 1.65 V common-mode point

hi_cm250.description: as hi_cm080, at the 2.5 V common-mode point

lo_cm250.description: as lo_cm080, at the 2.5 V common-mode point
